summary.tldr: Authorizes $20.8 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for federal public spending in 2022-23.
what_it_does: Authorizes payments to cover certain federal public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in the 2022-23 fiscal year.
Appropriates $20,796,964,176 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
Comes into force on Royal Assent.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 8 December 2022 and received Royal Assent on 15 December 2023.
